assumptions: Adopted the issue's smallest suggested fix (#1): scale the reported score by audit coverage (evaluable/applicable) rather than the exit-code or glyph changes (#2/#3).

Coverage scaling is linear and rounded: score = round(findingsScore * evaluable/applicable). 2 of 7 clean => 29; every pattern abstaining => 0; full coverage is the identity so a complete clean audit still earns 100.

Tier continues to key off the findings-only score (not the coverage-scaled score), so the coverage penalty on the number stays orthogonal to the incomplete/at-risk/theatre tier that #1013 introduced. A vacuous denominator (applicable<=0) passes the raw score through to avoid divide-by-zero.
